pages.text: Platform Operations Runbook. The platform team owns service health, incident response, deployment safety, and API reliability for the production application.
Incident response targets. Severity 1 incidents require an RTO of 4 hours and an RPO of 15 minutes. The incident commander must post updates every 30 minutes.
Deployment and rollback. Standard production deployments use canary release. If the error budget burn rate exceeds threshold, rollback must complete within 10 minutes.
API reliability. Public API clients are limited to 120 requests per minute per tenant. Burst traffic above the quota receives HTTP 429 responses.
Observability. Logs are retained for 30 days in the hot store. Metrics are retained for 13 months. Trace samples are retained for 14 days.

pages.text: Customer Support Policy. This policy describes refund windows, support escalation, account deletion, and backup retention for customer-facing operations.
Refunds. Self-service subscriptions may be refunded within 14 days of purchase if usage remains below the monthly included quota.
Enterprise escalation. Enterprise severity 1 support tickets receive a first human response within 2 hours and are reviewed by the duty manager.
Account deletion. Verified deletion requests are completed within 30 days. Customer backups that contain deleted account data expire within 90 days.
Data exports. Customers can request a JSON export of account configuration, billing contacts, and audit log metadata.
